reasoning: Shows a handheld megaphone/bullhorn with sound rays, the universal symbol for announcements, promotions, marketing campaigns, and public outreach. It fits both work tasks (launches, ads, press releases) and personal announcements (birth, graduation, neighborhood notices), as well as literal bullhorn tasks, though at tiny sizes its silhouette slightly resembles a flashlight or speaker cone.
